source_transform: C023/C034 linear witness-preserving 3-CNF -> Horn NAND3 + affine NEQ
measured_object: minimum worst-case source-orientation decision depth until every residual connected component is certified terminal by the frozen typed grammar
recurrence: d(q)=0 if typed-terminal; else min over unassigned source x of 1+max(d(q+x=0),d(q+x=1))
native_free_propagation: assigning source x_i simultaneously fixes its NEQ complement c_i=NOT x_i
candidate_authority: exact finite dynamic program over partial source assignments; measurement oracle only, not a universal SAT algorithm

ALTERNATING_PATH.sign_rule: literal i in window starting s is negated iff (s+i) mod 2 = 1

XOR3_CHAIN.constraint: x_i XOR x_{i+1} XOR x_{i+2}=0 encoded by four exact 3-CNF clauses per window

exact_checks: verify every transformed instance preserves source truth on all complete assignments for n<=8
verify source primal graph connected for corpus entries labeled connected
compute exact minimum depth with two independent variable-order traversals
record memo-state count, terminal-state count, optimal first-variable set, SAT label and source size
replay an optimal strategy tree on every complete source assignment for n<=8

interpretation_policy.small_depth: discovery evidence that reachable routing may remain compact on that frozen family only
interpretation_policy.large_depth: counterevidence to the current branching route on that frozen family only
interpretation_policy.next_if_small: seek a proved structural bound explaining the observed depth
